![An approval card showing the change Genos proposes, with Approve, Edit and Reject buttons](/lp/shots/en/approval.webp)

At the end of a long thread you want it turned into action: a to-do for tomorrow, a task for the follow-up, a comment so the team knows. Asking an AI to do it is tempting. Letting it loose on your team's work is not.

## Why it is hard

A change made for you is a change you answer for. A wrong date, the wrong project or a comment in the wrong tone reaches your teammates before you notice. So people either do everything by hand or let the AI act and then go looking for what it did.

## How Genos helps

Before every change it makes, Genos AI, the one built into the app, shows you a card titled **Approval required** with what it will create or change.

```flow
Ask for a change
Read the card
Edit if needed
Approve or reject
```

Read it, then **Approve** or **Reject**. For many changes you can press **Edit** first and fix a title, a date or a sentence, so a nearly right proposal does not mean starting over.

A card marked **Can't be undone** warns you before you approve; adding a to-do is one of those. When Genos creates or edits a task or a note, or adds a comment, an **Undo** button appears afterwards. It works for up to 7 days and only puts back what nobody has changed since. It cannot take back a notification that was already sent.

## What you get

- **The typing without the risk of surprises.** Genos drafts, you decide.
- **A last look at the details** that matter: who, when, where.
- **Delegation you can build up.** Start with small things such as a to-do, and hand over more once you have seen how it proposes them.

## Which plan does what

On Free, Genos answers and summarizes but changes nothing; ask it for a task and it writes the text for you to paste. On Core it can make one change at a time. Pro and Max can also make larger ones in a step, such as a milestone with its tasks.

This approval step is about Genos AI. An app you connect, such as Claude, writes at once, within the access you gave it.

## How to start

1. Press Cmd-K (Ctrl-K).
2. Ask for something small: "Add a to-do for tomorrow: review the draft."
3. Read the card, change what you want, approve.
